lines.say: The Cubs' ring counts one hundred eight years.

lines.text: The Cubs won the 2016 World Series after waiting 108 years.
lines.say: The Cubs won the twenty sixteen World Series after waiting one hundred eight years.

lines.text: Their ring has 108 round white diamonds in its bezel.
lines.say: Their ring has one hundred eight round white diamonds in its bezel.

lines.text: That is one diamond for each year of the wait.
In all, each ring carries 214 diamonds, set in white gold.
lines.say: In all, each ring carries two hundred fourteen diamonds, set in white gold.

lines.text: Two princess cut diamonds flank the trophy, one for each earlier title.
The band reads We Never Quit.
Players received the rings on April 12, 2017, at Wrigley Field.
lines.say: Players received the rings on April twelfth, twenty seventeen, at Wrigley Field.

lines.text: Inside the band is stamped 12:47 am, the time of the win.
lines.say: Inside the band is stamped twelve forty seven a m, the time of the win.

post.caption: The Cubs' ring counts 108 years. The Cubs won the 2016 World Series after waiting 108 years, and the bezel of their ring holds 108 round white diamonds, one for each year. In all, each ring carries 214 diamonds set in white gold. Two princess cut diamonds flank the trophy, one for each earlier title. The band reads We Never Quit. Players received the rings on April 12, 2017, at Wrigley Field. Inside, the band is stamped 12:47 am, the time of the win.
